commands: set -eu; git fetch --prune origin main >/dev/null; test "$(git rev-parse origin/main)" = "dfd2ceb703d74fb667916073ccd4a0f75eb1c0e8"; adb start-server >/dev/null; serial="$(adb devices | awk 'NR>1 && $2=="device" {print $1; exit}')"; test -n "$serial"; model="$(adb -s "$serial" shell getprop ro.product.model | tr -d '\r')"; test "$model" = "SM-S906B"; adb -s "$serial" shell pm path io.blueeye >/dev/null; adb -s "$serial" shell run-as io.blueeye id >/dev/null; echo CAPTURE_DEVICE_OK:$model

set -eu; DIR="$HOME/tracker-field-captures/2026-09-13-post-walk-v68"; mkdir -p "$DIR"; chmod 700 "$HOME/tracker-field-captures" "$DIR"; serial="$(adb devices | awk 'NR>1 && $2=="device" {print $1; exit}')"; { echo source_sha=dfd2ceb703d74fb667916073ccd4a0f75eb1c0e8; echo captured_utc="$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"; echo model="$(adb -s "$serial" shell getprop ro.product.model | tr -d '\r')"; echo android_release="$(adb -s "$serial" shell getprop ro.build.version.release | tr -d '\r')"; echo android_sdk="$(adb -s "$serial" shell getprop ro.build.version.sdk | tr -d '\r')"; echo app_pid="$(adb -s "$serial" shell pidof io.blueeye | tr -d '\r' || true)"; } > "$DIR/capture-metadata.txt"; adb -s "$serial" shell dumpsys package io.blueeye > "$DIR/package-dumpsys.txt"; adb -s "$serial" shell dumpsys activity services io.blueeye > "$DIR/services-dumpsys.txt"; adb -s "$serial" logcat -d -v threadtime -t 5000 | grep -E 'io\.blueeye|BlueEye|FATAL EXCEPTION|AndroidRuntime' > "$DIR/blueeye-logcat.txt" || true; echo RUNTIME_EVIDENCE_CAPTURED

set -eu; DIR="$HOME/tracker-field-captures/2026-09-13-post-walk-v68"; serial="$(adb devices | awk 'NR>1 && $2=="device" {print $1; exit}')"; found=0; for f in tracker_database tracker_database-wal tracker_database-shm; do if adb -s "$serial" shell run-as io.blueeye sh -c "test -f databases/$f" >/dev/null 2>&1; then adb -s "$serial" exec-out run-as io.blueeye cat "databases/$f" > "$DIR/$f"; test -s "$DIR/$f"; found=1; fi; done; test "$found" = 1; if adb -s "$serial" shell run-as io.blueeye sh -c 'test -f cache/session_exports/blueeye-session-export.json' >/dev/null 2>&1; then adb -s "$serial" exec-out run-as io.blueeye cat cache/session_exports/blueeye-session-export.json > "$DIR/blueeye-session-export.json"; test -s "$DIR/blueeye-session-export.json"; echo SESSION_EXPORT_COPIED; else echo SESSION_EXPORT_NOT_PRESENT_IN_APP_CACHE; fi; echo ROOM_CAPTURED

set -eu; DIR="$HOME/tracker-field-captures/2026-09-13-post-walk-v68"; serial="$(adb devices | awk 'NR>1 && $2=="device" {print $1; exit}')"; apk_path="$(adb -s "$serial" shell pm path io.blueeye | sed -n 's/^package://p' | head -1 | tr -d '\r')"; if test -n "$apk_path"; then adb -s "$serial" pull "$apk_path" "$DIR/installed-base.apk" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; fi; if command -v sqlite3 >/dev/null 2>&1 && test -s "$DIR/tracker_database"; then sqlite3 "$DIR/tracker_database" 'PRAGMA integrity_check;' > "$DIR/sqlite-integrity.txt" 2>&1 || true; fi; (cd "$DIR" && shasum -a 256 * > SHA256SUMS.txt); chmod -R go-rwx "$DIR"; echo CAPTURE_DIR=$DIR; echo CAPTURE_FILES_BEGIN; find "$DIR" -maxdepth 1 -type f -exec basename {} \; | sort; echo CAPTURE_FILES_END; if test -f "$DIR/sqlite-integrity.txt"; then printf 'SQLITE_INTEGRITY='; tr '\n' ' ' < "$DIR/sqlite-integrity.txt" | head -c 200; echo; fi
